title: A Clash Between Religious Faith and Gay Rights

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.

And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: And this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: On Friday, the Supreme Court delivered another major decision on the last day of its term, ruling in favor of a web designer who argued that having to create websites
sentences.zh: 周五，最高法院在其任期最后一天又做出了一项重大裁决，支持了一位网页设计师，她辩称被迫制作网站

sentences.en: for same-sex marriages violated her right to free speech.
sentences.zh: 用于同性婚姻侵犯了她的言论自由权。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Adam Liptak on how the ruling puts freedom of expression above freedom from discrimination.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事亚当·利普塔克将探讨这项裁决如何将表达自由置于免受歧视的自由之上。

sentences.en: And what that might mean for all kinds of different groups of Americans.
sentences.zh: 以及这对各类美国群体可能意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Monday, July 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月3日，星期一。

sentences.en: Adam, you're back.
sentences.zh: 亚当，你回来了。

sentences.en: Hello, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 你好，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: So this time you're here for another major case.
sentences.zh: 所以这次你是因为另一个重大案件而来的。

sentences.en: It's one potentially with far-reaching consequences for same-sex couples.
sentences.zh: 这可能对同性伴侣产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: Tell me about the ruling.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说这个裁决吧。

sentences.en: So this is the end of June when we get the big cases.
sentences.zh: 六月底是我们处理重大案件的时候。

sentences.en: And this is one we've been waiting for for many months.
sentences.zh: 这是我们期待已久的案件之一。

sentences.en: The question is whether a website designer with religious convictions can refuse to provide services to same-sex couples for same-sex marriages.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，一位有宗教信仰的网站设计师能否拒绝为同性伴侣的同性婚姻提供服务。

sentences.en: And the court, by the usual six-to-three split, with the six Republican appointees in the majority, says yes, she can.
sentences.zh: 法院以通常的六比三票数，由六名共和党任命的法官占多数，裁定她可以拒绝。

sentences.en: She has a First Amendment free speech right not to be compelled by the government to say things she doesn't believe.
sentences.zh: 她拥有第一修正案赋予的言论自由权，即政府不能强迫她说出她不相信的话。

sentences.en: She says that same-sex marriages are false and that in having to comply with a Colorado anti-discrimination law that forbids discrimination on many grounds,
sentences.zh: 她认为同性婚姻是错误的，而遵守科罗拉多州禁止在多方面进行歧视的反歧视法，

sentences.en: including sexual orientation, the government is making her violate her free speech rights by compelling her to say something she doesn't believe.
sentences.zh: 包括性取向，是在强迫她说出她不相信的话，从而侵犯了她的言论自由权。

sentences.en: In other words, she has the right not to make a website for same-sex couples who are getting married because they're same-sex couples, something she disagrees with.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，她有权拒绝为正在结婚的同性伴侣制作网站，因为她是同性伴侣，而她对此持反对意见。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there is an established First Amendment doctrine called compelled speech that says you can't force schoolchildren to say the Pledge of Allegiance.
sentences.zh: 第一修正案中有一项既定的原则，称为“强制言论”，即你不能强迫学生背诵效忠誓词。

sentences.en: You can't require people to, in New Hampshire, have a license plate that says live free or die.
sentences.zh: 你不能要求新罕布什尔州的人们使用写着“不自由，毋宁死”的车牌。

sentences.en: And whether that concept fits neatly here is open to question.
sentences.zh: 这一概念是否完全适用于此尚存疑问。

sentences.en: But the Supreme Court adopts that concept, or the majority does, and says that this anti-discrimination law, as applied to a web designer, engaged in expressive conduct,
sentences.zh: 但最高法院采纳了这一概念，或者说多数派采纳了，并表示这项反歧视法在应用于从事表达性行为的网页设计师时，

sentences.en: violates the First Amendment.
sentences.zh: 违反了第一修正案。

sentences.en: This is sounding vaguely familiar.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点耳熟。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about that case a while back about a cake baker who didn't want to bake a cake for a same-sex wedding, also in Colorado.
sentences.zh: 我想起了前段时间那个蛋糕师的案子，他不想为同性婚礼制作蛋糕，也是在科罗拉多州。

sentences.en: It was about five miles away from where this web designer works.
sentences.zh: 距离这位网页设计师工作的地方大约只有五英里。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You're right to remember that case.
sentences.zh: 你记得那个案子是对的。

sentences.en: It involved a baker named Jack Phillips who made custom wedding cakes.
sentences.zh: 那涉及一位名叫杰克·菲利普斯的烘焙师，他制作定制婚礼蛋糕。

sentences.en: He said they were artistic works.
sentences.zh: 他说那是艺术作品。

sentences.en: And he refused service to a same-sex couple,
sentences.zh: 他拒绝为一对同性伴侣提供服务，

sentences.en: was punished for it.
sentences.zh: 并因此受到了惩罚。

sentences.en: That case went all the way to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 那个案子一直打到了最高法院。

sentences.en: But we didn't get a definitive decision in that case.
sentences.zh: 但我们并没有在那个案子中得到一个明确的裁决。

sentences.en: And remind me why, Adam?
sentences.zh: 提醒我一下为什么，亚当？

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: I think the real reason was that the controlling vote was that of Justice Anthony Kennedy, since retired.
sentences.zh: 我认为真正的原因是，起决定性作用的投票来自安东尼·肯尼迪大法官，他现已退休。

sentences.en: Justice Kennedy was, on the one hand, the court's greatest proponent of gay rights, the author of all four major constitutional pro-gay rights decisions, but also very sensitive
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪大法官一方面是法院同性恋权利的最大支持者，是所有四项重大宪法同性恋权利裁决的作者，但也对

sentences.en: to First Amendment free speech concerns.
sentences.zh: 第一修正案的言论自由问题非常敏感。

sentences.en: And I just don't think he could make up his mind.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得他无法下定决心。

sentences.en: So he ultimately found an off-ramp ruling in favor of the baker on quite narrow, technical, idiosyncratic grounds.
sentences.zh: 所以他最终找到了一个折中方案，以非常狭隘、技术性且独特的理由支持了烘焙师。

sentences.en: None of that is important to follow.
sentences.zh: 这些细节都不重要。

sentences.en: The only larger point is that there was no decision.
sentences.zh: 唯一重要的结论是，当时没有做出明确裁决。

sentences.en: And we've been waiting now for years for the Supreme Court to return to this topic.
sentences.zh: 我们已经等了多年，等待最高法院重新审理这个话题。

sentences.en: Okay, so now this case comes along with this web designer.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在这个网页设计师的案子来了。

sentences.en: Tell me about her, the person at the heart of the case.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说她，这个案件核心的人物。

sentences.en: Her name is Lori Smith.
sentences.zh: 她的名字是洛里·史密斯。

sentences.en: I paid her a visit some months ago as the case was soon to be argued.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，在案件即将开庭辩论时，我拜访了她。

sentences.en: So Lori, tell me about you.
sentences.zh: 那么洛里，跟我说说你自己。

sentences.en: Tell me about your business.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你的生意。

sentences.en: What do you do here?
sentences.zh: 你在这里做什么？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So you're in my studio.
sentences.zh: 你现在在我的工作室里。

sentences.en: This is 303 Creative here in Littleton, Colorado.
sentences.zh: 这是位于科罗拉多州利特尔顿的303 Creative。

sentences.en: And she told me her story.
sentences.zh: 她告诉了我她的故事。

sentences.en: So I'm from a family of entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: 我来自一个创业家庭。

sentences.en: I always wanted to own my own business and I've always been creative.
sentences.zh: 我一直想拥有自己的生意，而且我一直很有创造力。

sentences.en: She starts her own business, which makes ads and logos and websites.
sentences.zh: 她创办了自己的公司，制作广告、标志和网站。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So custom logos, custom artwork, custom designs.
sentences.zh: 所以是定制标志、定制艺术品、定制设计。

sentences.en: For a variety of businesses.
sentences.zh: 为各种企业服务。

sentences.en: Nothing I create.
sentences.zh: 我创造的东西没有重复的。

sentences.en: No two things are the same.
sentences.zh: 没有两样东西是完全一样的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So everything's custom expression and artwork and nature.
sentences.zh: 所以一切都是定制的表达、艺术品和自然创作。

sentences.en: And she sees herself as an artist and thinks that every piece of work she does for this business is unique.
sentences.zh: 她把自己视为艺术家，认为她为这项业务所做的每一件作品都是独一无二的。

sentences.en: So my clients are coming to me because they're not looking for like a boilerplate template.
sentences.zh: 我的客户来找我，是因为他们不是在寻找那种千篇一律的模板。

sentences.en: And she also says she's eager to go into a new business.
sentences.zh: 她还说她渴望进入一个新的业务领域。

sentences.en: She wants to provide websites for weddings.
sentences.zh: 她想为婚礼提供网站。

sentences.en: When I started creating,
sentences.zh: 当我开始创作时，

sentences.en: I made a decision that the things that I create and design for, they would be honoring and glorifying to God.
sentences.zh: 我做了一个决定，我创作和设计的东西，都必须是荣耀上帝的。

sentences.en: And because of that, that means that I can't create all messages.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，这意味着我不能创作所有的信息。

sentences.en: But she says her Christian faith would not allow her to create websites for same-sex weddings.
sentences.zh: 但她说她的基督教信仰不允许她为同性婚礼制作网站。

sentences.en: And I want to create weddings consistent with my faith, which teaches me that
sentences.zh: 我想创作符合我信仰的婚礼网站，我的信仰教导我，

sentences.en: marriage is between one man and one woman.
sentences.zh: 婚姻是一男一女之间的结合。

sentences.en: She says she'll serve gay couples in all kinds of settings.
sentences.zh: 她说她会为各种背景的同性伴侣服务。

sentences.en: I love everyone.
sentences.zh: 我爱每一个人。

sentences.en: I serve everyone.
sentences.zh: 我为每一个人服务。

sentences.en: I have clients who identify as LGBT.
sentences.zh: 我有认同LGBT的客户。

sentences.en: I just can't promote every message.
sentences.zh: 我只是不能推广所有的信息。

sentences.en: Just not in connection with same-sex marriages.
sentences.zh: 只是不能与同性婚姻有关。

sentences.en: But the state says that I can't do that.
sentences.zh: 但州政府说我不能这样做。

sentences.en: And she's afraid that if she goes into this business but only serves opposite-sex couples, she'll be punished by the state of Colorado under its anti-discrimination laws.
sentences.zh: 她担心如果她进入这个行业但只为异性伴侣服务，她会根据科罗拉多州的反歧视法受到惩罚。

sentences.en: For me, I cautiously looked around at the nature of the environment in Colorado.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我谨慎地观察了科罗拉多州的环境。

sentences.en: And I saw what was happening with people like Jack Phillips, who has a similar faith to me.
sentences.zh: 我看到了像杰克·菲利普斯这样的人身上发生了什么，他有着和我相似的信仰。

sentences.en: And I wondered if the state could do the same to me.
sentences.zh: 我担心州政府是否也会对我做同样的事。

sentences.en: So what I did...
sentences.zh: 所以我所做的……

sentences.en: And she thinks that because she's actually familiar with the Cake Baker case.
sentences.zh: 她认为这样做是因为她确实熟悉蛋糕师的案子。

sentences.en: She knows Jack Phillips, the baker in the case.
sentences.zh: 她认识杰克·菲利普斯，那个案子里的烘焙师。

sentences.en: And she knew she might run the risk of getting in trouble with Colorado, as he did, if she were to turn down business based on same-sex marriages.
sentences.zh: 她知道如果她因为同性婚姻而拒绝业务，她可能会像他一样在科罗拉多州惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So how do you get involved in this lawsuit?
sentences.zh: 那你怎么卷入这场诉讼的？

sentences.en: Well, it started about six years ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这始于大约六年前。

sentences.en: And so she gets together with a big Christian litigating firm called Alliance Defending Freedom, which had also represented Jack Phillips.
sentences.zh: 她与一家名为“捍卫自由联盟”的大型基督教诉讼公司合作，该公司也曾代表过杰克·菲利普斯。

sentences.en: And they file suit.
sentences.zh: 他们提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: And they do so before she's actually opened her doors to this kind of business.
sentences.zh: 而且是在她还没正式开展这类业务之前就提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: They say that she has reason to be afraid that she'll face punishment if she starts into this business but won't serve same-sex couples for same-sex weddings.
sentences.zh: 他们说，她有理由担心，如果她开始从事这项业务但不为同性婚礼提供服务，她将面临惩罚。

sentences.en: And so rather than wait to be punished, I decided to take a stand to protect my First Amendment rights.
sentences.zh: 所以与其等着被惩罚，我决定站出来保护我的第一修正案权利。

sentences.en: And I shouldn't have to be punished before I challenge an unjust law.
sentences.zh: 我不应该在挑战不公正的法律之前就受到惩罚。

sentences.en: So there's really not a real-life dispute here, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这里并没有真正的现实纠纷，对吧？

sentences.en: She's just trying to kind of head off the potential for a dispute that she thinks she might have if she expands her business.
sentences.zh: 她只是试图防范她认为如果扩大业务可能会遇到的潜在纠纷。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the case with the cake maker, there was detailed record evidence in the court files on who had done what, when, and it really added some texture and context to the case.
sentences.zh: 在蛋糕师的案子中，法院档案中有详细的记录证据，说明了谁在何时做了什么，这确实为案件增加了一些背景和细节。

sentences.en: In this case,
sentences.zh: 在这个案子中，

sentences.en: Smith said she had received but never responded to a request from what looked like a same-sex couple.
sentences.zh: 史密斯说她收到过一个看起来像是同性伴侣的请求，但从未回复。

sentences.en: Now, according to recent reports, the request was bogus, submitted under the name of a straight man.
sentences.zh: 现在，根据最近的报道，那个请求是虚假的，是以一个直男的名义提交的。

sentences.en: But in any event, the case is very different from that of the baker.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，这个案子与烘焙师的案子非常不同。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He actually had denied baking a cake to an actual couple, right?
sentences.zh: 他确实拒绝为一对真实的伴侣制作蛋糕，对吧？

sentences.en: So, as you say, they were facts in the case.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如你所说，那是案件中的事实。

sentences.en: Here, she hasn't denied service to anyone.
sentences.zh: 在这里，她并没有拒绝为任何人提供服务。

sentences.en: It's kind of something that might happen in the future.
sentences.zh: 这更像是未来可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we don't know what the request would look like.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道请求会是什么样子。

sentences.en: We don't know what any resulting website would look like.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道由此产生的网站会是什么样子。

sentences.en: It's an odd thing to have a Supreme Court decision based on so little evidence.
sentences.zh: 基于如此少的证据做出最高法院裁决是一件奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: But obviously, nonetheless, the case makes it all the way up to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 但显然，尽管如此，这个案子还是打到了最高法院。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you have to think
sentences.zh: 你不得不认为

sentences.en: that Alliance Defending Freedom had wanted to find another plaintiff in another case to get back to the Supreme Court, particularly as its composition had changed, as it had become
sentences.zh: “捍卫自由联盟”想要在另一个案件中找到另一个原告，以便回到最高法院，特别是随着法院组成的变化，因为它变得

sentences.en: more conservative.
sentences.zh: 更加保守了。

sentences.en: And when the case arrives at the Supreme Court, it seems like a sequel to the case about the baker.
sentences.zh: 当这个案子到达最高法院时，它看起来像是烘焙师案的续集。

sentences.en: And it is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But the baker's case had two pieces to it.
sentences.zh: 但烘焙师的案子有两部分。

sentences.en: It had a religious component, whether the Colorado anti-discrimination law violated his right to free exercise of religion, and also whether it violated his right to free speech,
sentences.zh: 它有一个宗教成分，即科罗拉多州的反歧视法是否侵犯了他自由行使宗教的权利，以及它是否侵犯了他的言论自由权，

sentences.en: to free expression.
sentences.zh: 即表达自由。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: This time around, the court only grants the free speech question.
sentences.zh: 这一次，法院只受理了言论自由的问题。

sentences.en: So we're looking at a case which has heavy overtones of a classic clash between religion and gay rights, but it takes the form of a question about free speech.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到的这个案子带有宗教与同性恋权利之间经典冲突的浓厚色彩，但它采取了关于言论自由问题的形式。

sentences.en: Okay, so instead of this being a fight about religion and free speech versus discrimination, it's just free speech versus discrimination.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这不再是一场关于宗教和言论自由对抗歧视的斗争，而仅仅是言论自由对抗歧视。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The court apparently thought the best way to handle this question is in a streamlined fashion and really bear down on whether the First Amendment's free expression protection
sentences.zh: 法院显然认为处理这个问题的最好方法是以精简的方式，真正深入探讨第一修正案的表达自由保护

sentences.en: applies even in the face of an anti-discrimination law.
sentences.zh: 是否在面对反歧视法时依然适用。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是 Wena Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game
sentences.zh: 我负责编写游戏

sentences.en: of these two guys together.

sentences.zh: 凯坦吉大法官

sentences.zh: 你能谈谈你对购物中心在节日期间提供一种名为“与圣诞老人合影”产品的摄影业务的看法吗？

sentences.zh: 而这家企业想要表达自己对怀旧的看法，关于……

sentences.zh: 假设一家购物中心想要营造一种

sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代深褐色调的

sentences.zh: 所以她似乎在暗示，支持 Smith 的裁决可能会远远超出网页设计师的宗教异议，这可能是一条滑坡谬误。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: But even if it were, this court has protected vile, awful, reprehensible, violent speech in the past, and it is never compulsive.
sentences.zh: 但即使是这样，本法院过去也保护过卑劣、恶心、应受谴责、暴力的言论，而且它从不强制执行。

sentences.en: No, I'm just asking you, why is the objection

sentences.zh: 一个需要认识到的重要点是，让我们回想一下，我们讨论的不仅仅是宗教信仰。

sentences.en: It could protect all kinds of discrimination.

sentences.en: So long as we're talking about expressive speech delivered on a custom basis.

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, some of the conservative justices suggested there might be a slippery slope in the other direction as well.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一些保守派大法官暗示，在另一个方向上也可能存在滑坡谬误。

sentences.en: But the problem, and what a lot of the hypotheticals are getting at, is however we decide this case obviously applies to others.
sentences.zh: 但问题在于，以及许多假设性问题所指向的，是我们如何裁决此案显然会适用于其他人。

sentences.en: And what if we say it's not the case?
sentences.zh: 如果我们说情况并非如此呢？

sentences.en: And in court, the justices were grappling with, well, where would the line be if this Colorado law was left in place?

sentences.en: Couldn't that leave the door open to at least some companies having to take on all kinds of work that they deeply disagree with?

sentences.en: Does every press release writer, freelance writer, have to write a press release for the Church of Scientology, say, even though the beliefs of that institution may be

sentences.en: inimical to the person?
sentences.zh: 对那个人有害？

sentences.en: And the more the justices talk, the more it becomes apparent that they're finding these questions to be pretty hard.
sentences.zh: 大法官们谈论得越多，就越明显地看出他们发现这些问题相当棘手。

sentences.en: You could say, So the answer is yes,
sentences.zh: 你可以说，所以答案是肯定的，

sentences.en: Colorado would compel that person.
sentences.zh: 科罗拉多州会强制那个人这样做。

sentences.en: The answer is no.
sentences.zh: 答案是否定的。

sentences.en: Okay, why?
sentences.zh: 好的，为什么？

sentences.en: Because Colorado...
sentences.zh: 因为科罗拉多州……

sentences.en: So there are, as lawyers like to say, a lot of line-drawing questions here.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如律师们常说的，这里有很多划界的问题。

sentences.en: At the conclusion of the argument, though,
sentences.zh: 不过，在辩论结束时，

sentences.en: I think I thought and most observers thought that the six-justice conservative majority would find a way to rule for Lori Smith was basically sympathetic to her position.
sentences.zh: 我想我以为，大多数观察家也认为，六位保守派大法官组成的多数派会找到一种支持 Lori Smith 的裁决方式，他们基本上同情她的立场。

sentences.en: And that may have been inflected by the particular context of the case that she was a Christian woman opposed to same-sex marriage.
sentences.zh: 这可能受到了该案特定背景的影响，即她是一位反对同性婚姻的基督徒女性。

sentences.en: And this is a court that's very receptive to claims based on religion, particularly from Christians, and maybe is not as sympathetic in cases involving gay rights as it might be
sentences.zh: 这是一个对基于宗教的主张非常接纳的法院，特别是来自基督徒的主张，而在涉及同性恋权利的案件中，可能不像在

sentences.en: in other cases involving other forms of discrimination.
sentences.zh: 涉及其他形式歧视的案件中那样具有同情心。

sentences.en: And of course, Adam, you were right during the oral arguments to assume what you did assume.
sentences.zh: 当然，Adam，你在口头辩论期间假设得是对的。

sentences.en: That is exactly what they ruled.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们的裁决结果。

sentences.en: So tell me about the specifics of this decision.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我关于这项裁决的具体细节。

sentences.en: Justice Neil Gorsuch writes for the six-justice majority and he basically says, you know, it's true.
sentences.zh: Neil Gorsuch 大法官代表六位多数派大法官撰写了意见书，他基本上说，你知道，这是真的。

sentences.en: There are some hard questions here.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些难题。

sentences.en: There are some thorny questions.
sentences.zh: 有一些棘手的问题。

sentences.en: But the question in this particular case, he says, is an easy one.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，在这个特定案件中，问题很简单。

sentences.en: That Lori Smith has a First Amendment right not to be compelled by the government to make websites for same-sex weddings even in the face of a Colorado law
sentences.zh: Lori Smith 拥有第一修正案赋予的权利，即不被政府强制要求为同性婚礼制作网站，即使面对科罗拉多州

sentences.en: that prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation.
sentences.zh: 禁止基于性取向歧视的法律也是如此。

sentences.en: So basically, they duck the thorny issues and say she's right.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他们回避了棘手的问题，并说她是正确的。

sentences.en: They kind of take her argument at face value.
sentences.zh: 他们算是照单全收了她的论点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I guess I'd say they take her facts at face value because they said that she was basically an artist, that she was engaged in expression, she had earnestly held views
sentences.zh: 我想我会说他们照单全收了她的事实，因为他们说她基本上是一位艺术家，她从事的是表达活动，她对

sentences.en: about same-sex marriage, and that she shouldn't be forced to say something she didn't believe.
sentences.zh: 同性婚姻持有真诚的观点，而且她不应该被迫说出她不相信的事情。

sentences.en: And in Gorsuch's opinion, is there any limit to what a so-called expressive, creative business can do when it comes to denying services?
sentences.zh: 在 Gorsuch 的意见书中，所谓的表达性、创造性企业在拒绝服务方面有什么限制吗？

sentences.en: Like, if she,
sentences.zh: 比如，如果她，

sentences.en: Lori Smith, wanted to refuse services based on a different kind of belief, say, a belief that interracial marriage is wrong.
sentences.zh: Lori Smith，想要基于一种不同的信仰拒绝服务，比如，认为跨种族婚姻是错误的信仰。

sentences.en: Would denying a couple a wedding website be protected in that case, according to his opinion?
sentences.zh: 根据他的意见书，在这种情况下，拒绝为一对新人提供婚礼网站会受到保护吗？

sentences.en: So the decision is very closely tied to the facts of the particular case.
sentences.zh: 所以这项裁决与该特定案件的事实紧密相关。

sentences.en: But the logic of the decision certainly extends to other kinds of discrimination.
sentences.zh: 但该裁决的逻辑当然延伸到了其他类型的歧视。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I was particularly curious about what
sentences.zh: 我特别好奇

sentences.en: Justice Gorsuch would have to say about discrimination based on race.

sentences.en: And I was surprised enough that I wasn't finding that discussion that I did a word search in the document to make sure I wasn't missing something.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常惊讶，因为我没找到相关的讨论，所以我对文件进行了关键词搜索，以确保我没有遗漏什么。

sentences.en: And although the dissent discusses racial discrimination, there's nothing about that in the majority opinion.
sentences.zh: 虽然异议意见书讨论了种族歧视，但在多数派意见书中对此只字未提。

sentences.en: So the opinion leaves open two kinds of questions.
sentences.zh: 所以这项意见书留下了两类问题。

sentences.en: One of them, just how far some businesses can go in discriminating against people in various settings.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，企业在各种环境下歧视他人到底能走多远。

sentences.en: But it also doesn't answer the threshold question of what businesses qualify as expressive businesses in the first place.
sentences.zh: 但它也没有回答什么企业首先有资格被视为表达性企业这一门槛问题。

sentences.en: So Justice Gorsuch seems to studiously avoid drawing lines and distinctions and is deciding the particular case without announcing general legal principles.
sentences.zh: 所以 Gorsuch 大法官似乎刻意避免划定界限和区分，并在没有宣布一般法律原则的情况下裁决了该特定案件。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court usually is in the business of announcing general legal principles.
sentences.zh: 而最高法院通常负责宣布一般法律原则。

sentences.en: So as this decision kind of makes its way out into the world, you know, the majority has not defined exactly what an expressive business is.
sentences.zh: 所以随着这项裁决逐渐传播到世界各地，你知道，多数派并没有确切定义什么是表达性企业。

sentences.en: It feels like that's going to be the center of the debate, right, going forward.
sentences.zh: 感觉这将成为未来辩论的中心，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, this is incredibly squishy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这极其模糊。

sentences.en: And it seems like this opinion really does everything it can not to wade into that squishiness.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来这份意见书确实尽其所能不去涉足那种模糊地带。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you can portray that in two ways.
sentences.zh: 你可以从两个方面来描述它。

sentences.en: One, that it's narrowly focused, but the other, in not addressing those other scenarios, it may open the door to all kinds of litigation and mischief.
sentences.zh: 一方面，它重点狭窄；但另一方面，由于没有解决那些其他情况，它可能会为各种诉讼和混乱敞开大门。

sentences.en: And Justice Sonia Sotomayor's dissent sure makes the point that it's hard to distinguish based on the logic of the decision other kinds of discrimination.
